_comment: The neutrality lint's lists, read by neutrality.py; this file is excluded from the lint itself. tokens: the Pokus Platform's names that are not ordinary words (its accounts and units all contain the substring; its service names agent, exec, verify and eval are ordinary words and programming terms, so they are not listed). allowed: the only forms of the project name in code, besides the display name. allowed_lines: per file, the quoted words a line may consist of (one per line), with the reason.
